statusDetail: Regional access gating redirects homepage, category and unknown routes to login. Audit covers the public login gate, invalid-login recovery, privacy notice, contact form, Arabic locale, and indexing endpoints. Authenticated video/detail, playback, account, subscription and cancellation flows were not included because no credentials were provided and new registration is unavailable in this region.

page.notes: Public content is server-rendered; regional gating redirects content routes to /login.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated dark preference screenshot plus computed color-scheme probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page remains visually identical under prefers-color-scheme: dark and reports computed color-scheme "normal", showing a fixed dark palette rather than a declared preference-aware scheme.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion probe of matchMedia, active animations and CSS rules
checkOutcomes.evidence: The preference was active and the login page had no running animations or auto-advance to suppress.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-contrast screenshot corroborated by Lighthouse contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The high-contrast capture is unchanged; Lighthouse found red links at 2.75:1 and a green signup control at 2.51:1.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS feature probe and invalid-login state exercise
checkOutcomes.evidence: The browser API exists, but no view-transition CSS or authored transition was found; the form state changes abruptly.

checkOutcomes.method: Animation timeline and stylesheet probe across login and long privacy page
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scroll-linked effects or JavaScript-driven parallax were present, so the page avoids the main-thread anti-pattern.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS inspection and responsive screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: No custom pointer gesture surface, swipe control, or scroll-jacking behavior was present on the audited public paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Full-page screenshot and DOM/CSS inspection on the long privacy notice
checkOutcomes.evidence: The long privacy document has no progress indicator or scroll-state-aware navigation; its chrome remains static throughout a very long page.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM inspection of open login and cookie overlays
checkOutcomes.evidence: Open overlays are custom role=dialog divs; no dialog/popover or CSS anchor positioning primitives were found.

checkOutcomes.method: First-viewport and invalid-form walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: The login heading, focused invalid field, assertive error, and reset link make the current state and next action clear.

checkOutcomes.method: Load screenshots and regional-access context review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The on-load gate is required for this region, clearly explains the age/auth restriction, and does not masquerade as unrelated promotional content.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered DOM inspection of overlays
checkOutcomes.evidence: The login and cookie experiences use custom divs with role=dialog rather than native dialog/popover controls, requiring manual modality and dismissal behavior.

checkOutcomes.method: Desktop and mobile full-page screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Desktop renders a login dialog over a duplicate login/signup page, while mobile renders a separate gate, creating redundant chrome and competing signup messaging.

checkOutcomes.method: 360x800 layout metrics and screenshots on login/contact
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both mobile runs lacked a viewport meta tag and rendered a 1070 CSS-pixel desktop layout scaled down into a 360px device viewport.

checkOutcomes.method: Stylesheet feature probe plus multi-viewport screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: No container-query rules were found and the form/page shell does not genuinely adapt; Chrome scales a desktop-width canvas instead.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic focus/target-size probe and Lighthouse target-size audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Most controls have a visible 2px focus outline, but the checkbox has no outline and key recovery links are only 16px high; Lighthouse failed target size.

checkOutcomes.method: First-viewport screenshot, heading and control inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The gated page clearly says Login, presents email/password and recovery links, and explains that registration is unavailable in this region.

checkOutcomes.method: Category navigation attempt and login/register pathway review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The requested homepage and a category route both redirect to login, while the page states new registrations are unavailable in this region, leaving a new visitor with no path to the advertised content.

checkOutcomes.method: Empty-form submission walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: Submitting the login form empty focuses the email field and exposes “Please enter a valid email address” in an aria-live=assertive error region.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse and CDP trace
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 5.1s; the desktop trace measured LCP 1.86s, demonstrating poor mobile load performance despite zero CLS.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout-shift observers and Lighthouse CLS
checkOutcomes.evidence: Login CLS was 0 and contact CLS was 0.0069, both in the good range.

checkOutcomes.method: CDP trace long-task summary
checkOutcomes.evidence: The desktop trace captured one 408.77ms long task and 358.77ms total blocking time.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against DOM resource placement
checkOutcomes.evidence: The login load transferred 2.04MB, including a 1.55MB document and four parser-inserted very-high-priority stylesheets; mobile LCP was 5.1s.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse code coverage and HAR third-party totals
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 172KiB unused JavaScript, including 71KiB and 62KiB in two tag-manager bundles; 23 of 28 requests were third-party.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audits and DOM form/image inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse passed label, image-alt and landmark audits; visible login/contact fields have labels and inspected images have alt text.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse automated contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found multiple links at 2.75:1 and a signup control at 2.51:1, below WCAG minimums.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse tabindex audit and focus-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Two recovery links use tabindex=4, disrupting natural focus order, and the visible checkbox has no focus outline.

checkOutcomes.method: Desktop/mobile screenshots of login and privacy content
checkOutcomes.evidence: Text is crisp, aligned, and readable in the desktop captures; the long privacy notice uses clear sectioning and comfortable line length on desktop.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse viewport/target audits and 360x800 screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: The viewport declares user-scalable=no/maximum-scale=1 in Lighthouse, while primitive runs observed no effective viewport meta; the page is scaled from 1070px and recovery targets are only 16px high.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse console-error audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reported no console errors or uncaught exceptions.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM, Lighthouse document audits, and image inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype/charset and aspect ratio passed, but 14 of 24 inspected images omit explicit dimensions and three below-fold images are not lazy-loaded.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse best-practices/DevTools issue audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page is excluded from BFCache by no-store responses and Lighthouse logged a cookie inspector issue; deprecated APIs and source maps otherwise passed.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM and raw-HTML discoverability comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: Login has a descriptive title and meta description, both present in raw HTML; privacy and contact also have titles.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse SEO, direct robots fetch, and anchor/viewport probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Anchors are crawlable, but /robots.txt serves the login HTML (2,008 Lighthouse parse errors) and the mobile viewport disables zoom/does not map to device width.

checkOutcomes.method: Canonical/meta inspection plus robots and sitemap requests
checkOutcomes.evidence: Canonical URLs and sitemap.xml exist, but robots.txt is replaced by login HTML, making crawler policy invalid and inconsistent with the sitemap.

checkOutcomes.method: Entity applicability review of audited public pages
checkOutcomes.evidence: The login, contact, and legal notice pages are not article/product/event entities requiring rich-result metadata.
checkOutcomes.reason: Audited public pages do not represent a rich entity for which structured/share metadata is required.

checkOutcomes.method: Security-header and cookie primitives
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS and nosniff are absent; PHPSESSID is neither Secure nor HttpOnly and all seven cookies use SameSite=None.

checkOutcomes.method: Tracker enumeration and HAR origin accounting
checkOutcomes.evidence: The login page contacts seven third-party origins, including Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics; 23/28 requests and 482KB are third-party before login.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse prompt audits and login DOM inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt fires on load, but the only visible authentication method is password-based; no passkey/WebAuthn affordance is exposed.

checkOutcomes.method: Security-header primitive
checkOutcomes.evidence: X-Frame-Options is present, but HSTS, CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw HTML versus rendered DOM discoverability test
checkOutcomes.evidence: The raw server HTML contains 100% of rendered content tokens and retains title, h1 and description without JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: Overlay screenshots and repeated form-state exercise
checkOutcomes.evidence: The visible login dialog stays within the desktop viewport and repeated invalid submissions preserve the form and a single actionable error.

checkOutcomes.method: Manifest/service-worker and site-purpose review
checkOutcomes.evidence: A manifest exists, but this media service and authentication flow are intrinsically online; offline installability is not a reasonable core requirement.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited media/auth service is intrinsically online, so offline/installable behavior is contextual and not required.

checkOutcomes.method: Navigation to a guaranteed nonexistent URL
checkOutcomes.evidence: A nonexistent URL silently redirects to the normal login screen, with no not-found explanation or recovery state distinct from valid gated content.

checkOutcomes.method: Arabic locale DOM/CSS probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The Arabic page sets lang=ar but omits dir=rtl, remains largely English, and inspected CSS uses physical left/right positioning.

checkOutcomes.method: English privacy notice and Arabic locale content inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The localized surface remains mostly English and the privacy notice renders an English-only hand-formatted date (“April 16th, 2026”), with no locale-aware alternative observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Audited-surface content review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No time-zone-sensitive event, booking, schedule, or timestamp flow appears on the login, contact, or legal pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: No audited surface handles time-zone-sensitive events or times.

checkOutcomes.method: Login, registration notice, privacy and cookie-control review
checkOutcomes.evidence: Registration unavailability, credential changes, legal notices and privacy links are disclosed plainly; persistent login is not preselected in the inspected form.

checkOutcomes.method: Invalid login submission
checkOutcomes.evidence: Validation occurs after submission, focuses the relevant field, and announces a specific error assertively without blame.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM inspection of login and contact fields
checkOutcomes.evidence: Email and password inputs omit autocomplete tokens; contact email also omits autocomplete=email.

checkOutcomes.method: Public account-flow review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The login surface exposes password recovery and clearly discloses regional registration limits; no pricing, subscription continuity, or preselected consent was presented on audited public paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Image primitive and HAR analysis
checkOutcomes.evidence: Three images use legacy PNG/GIF formats, 14 images lack dimensions, three below-fold images are not lazy-loaded, and three raster images lack srcset.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse unused-code and HAR analysis
checkOutcomes.evidence: Two analytics bundles transfer about 296KB and Lighthouse marks about 133KB of them unused on the login page; total unused JS estimate is 172KiB.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR and tracker primitives
checkOutcomes.evidence: Third parties account for 23/28 requests and 482KB on a simple login page, including two tag-manager payloads and analytics before authentication.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent-facing intent and surface review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No developer intent or user-facing agent workflow is declared for the gated media/login and legal-information surfaces.
checkOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing capability or on-device inference use case is declared; this emerging principle is contextual.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent-facing intent and surface review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No developer intent or user-facing agent workflow is declared for the gated media/login and legal-information surfaces.
checkOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing capability or on-device inference use case is declared; this emerging principle is contextual.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline/post heap snapshots plus ten repeated invalid submissions
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten submissions DOM elements remained 697 and only one error remained; heap self-size rose 10.70MB to 11.33MB (5.9%), not an unbounded pattern in this bounded exercise.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap summary and Performance.memory sampling
checkOutcomes.evidence: Baseline heap self-size was 10.70MB with 182,753 heap nodes, proportionate to the login page; used JS heap was about 12.3MB.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap constructor comparison and DOM-count stability probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Neither heap summary reports Detached* constructors and the live DOM count stayed exactly 697 after ten repeated submissions.

principleOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing capability or on-device inference use case is declared; this emerging principle is contextual. No agent-facing capability or on-device inference use case is declared; this emerging principle is contextual.

paths.description: Homepage/login gate: primary regional entry, authentication, preference, accessibility, performance, privacy and invalid-submit behavior.
Representative content listing archetype; confirms regional redirect behavior.
Long-form legal/content archetype and privacy disclosure.
Representative public support form and narrow-screen behavior.
Guaranteed unknown route for HTTP/not-found recovery behavior.

findings.summary: Declare a preference-aware color scheme
findings.evidence: Dark screenshot is pixel-identical to default and computed color-scheme is normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: dark light and tokenized light/dark values driven by prefers-color-scheme.

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences do not improve already-failing contrast
findings.evidence: prefers-contrast capture is unchanged; Lighthouse reports 2.75:1 and 2.51:1 combinations.
findings.suggestedFix: Use higher-contrast red/green tokens and add forced-colors/prefers-contrast adaptations.

findings.summary: Form state changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: No view-transition CSS is present and invalid submission changes state immediately.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a short reduced-motion-safe same-document transition for error/state changes.

findings.summary: Long legal content lacks progress/orientation
findings.evidence: Full-page privacy capture shows a long document with static navigation and no progress indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll progress indicator and sticky section context.

findings.summary: Overlays rely on custom positioning
findings.evidence: DOM reports custom DIV dialogs for login and cookie management.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog/popover and CSS anchor positioning where attachment is needed.

findings.summary: Custom divs implement modal experiences
findings.evidence: DOM identifies three custom DIV dialog surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Migrate modal flows to <dialog> and transient controls to popover with declarative dismissal.

findings.summary: Login chrome is duplicated and visually noisy
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshot shows duplicate authentication and signup messaging behind the gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Render one context-appropriate gate and remove duplicate background authentication chrome.

findings.summary: Mobile receives a scaled desktop canvas
findings.evidence: 360x800 runs render a 1070 CSS-pixel canvas; viewport metadata is absent/ineffective.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, allow zoom, and rebuild layouts with intrinsic fluid sizing.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt to their available container
findings.evidence: Probe found no @container rules; mobile is scaled rather than reflowed.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable shells container-type and adapt spacing/columns with container queries.

findings.summary: Some keyboard/touch affordances are too small or invisible
findings.evidence: Focus probe and Lighthouse target-size audit identify the failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Ensure every target meets minimum size/spacing and add a visible :focus-visible style to the checkbox.

findings.summary: New regional visitors reach a dead end
findings.evidence: Homepage and category route end at login; page explicitly says registration is unavailable in this region.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a compliant age-verification route, a clear regional availability explanation, or a lawful alternative path rather than an account dead end.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP is slow
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports LCP 5.1s; desktop trace reports 1.86s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP content and reduce document/script work on mobile.

findings.summary: A long task blocks the main thread
findings.evidence: Trace summary records a 408.77ms task and 358.77ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the long task, split work, and defer non-critical initialization.

findings.summary: The simple login load transfers 2.04MB
findings.evidence: HAR reports 2.04MB, a 1.55MB document, and four very-high-priority parser stylesheets.
findings.suggestedFix: Shrink server HTML, inline only critical CSS, and defer non-critical styles/scripts.

findings.summary: Large unused JavaScript ships on login
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 172KiB unused JS; 23/28 requests are third-party.
findings.suggestedFix: Conditionally load analytics and route-specific bundles after consent/need.

findings.summary: Important text and controls fail contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measures ratios down to 2.51:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace failing color tokens with combinations meeting 4.5:1 for normal text.

findings.summary: Focus order and visibility are inconsistent
findings.evidence: Lighthouse finds tabindex=4 on two links; focus probe finds outline none on checkbox.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove positive tabindex and provide consistent :focus-visible styling.

findings.summary: Zoom is disabled and mobile does not reflow
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags user-scalable=no; 360px primitive run renders 1070 CSS pixels.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow pinch zoom and implement true responsive reflow at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Image markup omits stability/loading hints
findings.evidence: Image primitive reports 14 missing dimensions and three below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width/height or aspect-ratio and loading=lazy for offscreen images.

findings.summary: The login page cannot use BFCache
findings.evidence: Lighthouse lists three BFCache failure reasons and a cookie inspector issue.
findings.suggestedFix: Limit no-store and cookie mutation to responses/state that genuinely require them.

findings.summary: robots.txt serves HTML instead of crawler rules
findings.evidence: Direct fetch returns login HTML and Lighthouse reports 2,008 robots errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid text/plain robots.txt without regional login interception.

findings.summary: Robots and sitemap indexing signals conflict
findings.evidence: sitemap.xml returns a populated index, but robots.txt is login HTML.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore valid robots rules and verify they align with sitemap URLs and regional gating.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie protections are incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers omit CSP/HSTS/nosniff; PHPSESSID lacks Secure and HttpOnly; all cookies use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP and HSTS, add nosniff, and scope cookies with Secure, HttpOnly and appropriate SameSite.

findings.summary: Tracking starts on the login page
findings.evidence: Seven third-party origins, two known trackers, 23/28 requests and 482KB third-party traffic were observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential analytics on consent and remove third parties without direct login value.

findings.summary: Authentication exposes no phishing-resistant option
findings.evidence: DOM/form inspection finds password fields and no passkey/WebAuthn affordance; prompt-on-load audits pass.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey/WebAuthn sign-in alongside password recovery.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced policies are mostly absent
findings.evidence: Header primitive finds no HSTS, CSP, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS, CSP with frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Unknown routes have no distinct recovery state
findings.evidence: 404 probe final URL is /login with no not-found explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve an explicit not-found/error state with links back to valid public routes.

findings.summary: Arabic localization is incomplete and lacks RTL semantics
findings.evidence: Arabic probe reports lang=ar, empty dir, English paragraphs, and physical left/right CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Set dir=rtl, replace physical properties with logical ones, and complete translation coverage.

findings.summary: Locale-sensitive content is hard-formatted in English
findings.evidence: Privacy shows “April 16th, 2026”; Arabic login remains largely English.
findings.suggestedFix: Use Intl.DateTimeFormat and localized message catalogs for visible dates and copy.

findings.summary: Login and contact inputs omit autocomplete hints
findings.evidence: DOM reports empty autocomplete on login email/password and contact email.
findings.suggestedFix: Add username/current-password/email autocomplete tokens as appropriate.

findings.summary: Several image assets are not efficiently delivered
findings.evidence: Image inventory reports legacy PNG/GIF, no srcset on raster images and eager below-fold assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Use AVIF/WebP where suitable, responsive sources, explicit dimensions and lazy loading.

findings.summary: Analytics code does substantial unused work
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports ~133KB unused across two analytics bundles.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redundant tags and load non-essential analytics conditionally after consent.

findings.summary: Third-party cost is disproportionate to login value
findings.evidence: HAR records 23/28 third-party requests and 482KB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Set and enforce a login-page third-party budget; defer ads/analytics until needed.
